selection_rationale: Uniform 3g torpedo-boat swarm: all corvettes move at the same fast speed, so the fleet can dictate range, evade heavy capital fire, and mass torpedoes for saturation strikes that overwhelm point defense.
formation_rationale: Corvettes clustered within ~100km for overlapping PD coverage against torpedoes, with slight forward stagger to screen and lateral/vertical spread to complicate enemy spinal weapon geometry while keeping two ships held back as reserve.
